general_skills.title: Ultra-Short First Search (3-5 Words)
general_skills.principle: Your FIRST search must be 3-5 words only: product type + 1 key attribute (color or gender). NEVER include price, fabric, fit, wash method, or size in the search query. Example: 'men's dress shirts green' or 'women's running shoes black'. These extra words cause zero results.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Before typing your very first search query.

general_skills.title: Never Repeat Same Search
general_skills.principle: Before every search, recall what you already searched. If you are about to type the same query, you MUST change it: remove a word or try a synonym. Repeating identical searches wastes steps.

general_skills.title: Simplify on Poor Results (Remove Words)
general_skills.principle: If results are irrelevant, REMOVE words from query to broaden results. Never add more words. Go from 5 words down to 3 words. If color is unusual, drop it and search just the product type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After any search returns obviously wrong product types.

general_skills.title: Only Click Matching Product Category
general_skills.principle: On the results page, READ product titles. Only click items whose title contains your exact product type (e.g., 'dress shirt' not 'T-shirt'). If no title matches, go back and search differently—do NOT click random items.
general_skills.when_to_apply: On every search results page before clicking any product.

general_skills.title: Select ALL Variants Before Buying
general_skills.principle: Before clicking 'Buy Now', you MUST explicitly select: (1) correct color variant matching task EXACTLY, and (2) correct size matching task EXACTLY. If either required option is not available in the list, leave this product immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: On every product page, after confirming product type matches.

general_skills.title: Match Color Variant EXACTLY
general_skills.principle: Select the color whose name exactly matches the task. 'navy blue' ≠ 'blue'. 'patina green' must be selected as 'patina green', not 'green'. If the exact color name is not in the options, this product cannot work—leave immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When choosing color on any product page.

general_skills.title: Check Price After Variant Selection
general_skills.principle: After selecting exact color and size, check the displayed price. If price exceeds your budget, leave immediately. Do NOT buy over-budget items.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After selecting all variants, before clicking Buy Now.

general_skills.title: Buy Within 8 Steps
general_skills.principle: You have 15 steps max. A successful purchase takes 4-7 steps: search→click product→select color→select size→buy. If by step 8 you haven't found a product, drastically simplify your search to just the product type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Track your step count. Past step 7 without a candidate, change strategy immediately.

general_skills.title: Never Re-Click Same Product
general_skills.principle: If you already visited a product and it was wrong, NEVER click it again. Move to a different product or change your search query.

apparel.title: Apparel Search Formula
apparel.principle: For clothing: search ONLY [product type] [color]. Examples: 'dress shirts green', 'women's shorts gray', 'men's polo navy'. Do NOT include fabric, fit, wash method, sleeve length, or size in the search. Verify those on the product page.

apparel.title: Verify Product Category on Page
apparel.principle: On the product page, check the title matches your garment type exactly. 'T-shirt' is NOT 'dress shirt'. 'Polo' is NOT 'henley'. 'Tank top' is NOT 'blouse'. If category doesn't match, leave IMMEDIATELY.
apparel.when_to_apply: First thing after opening any product page.

apparel.title: Color Variant: Exact Match or Leave
apparel.principle: Apparel variant names can be coded (e.g., 'c3-black', 'a1-green'). Select the option that exactly matches your task color. If your color is not in the options list, this product is wrong—leave immediately.
apparel.when_to_apply: When selecting color on an apparel product page.

apparel.title: Size Must Be Exact
apparel.principle: Select the exact size from your task. '2x' might appear as '2x-large' or 'xx-large'—pick the matching one. If your exact size isn't listed, the product doesn't work. Don't buy a different size.
apparel.when_to_apply: When selecting size on any apparel product page.

apparel.title: After Failed Product: Change Search
apparel.principle: If the product you clicked was wrong, go back to search and modify your query. Remove a word or try a synonym. Don't just click next page of bad results.
apparel.when_to_apply: After leaving an unsuitable product page.

footwear.title: Footwear Search: Type + Feature
footwear.principle: Search format: [shoe type] [1 key feature]. Examples: 'men's boots waterproof', 'women's pumps open toe', 'running shoes black'. Keep to 3-5 words.

footwear.title: Verify Shoe Type First
footwear.principle: On the product page, confirm the title states the exact shoe type requested (boots ≠ loafers ≠ sneakers). If wrong type, leave immediately.
footwear.when_to_apply: Right after opening a footwear product page.

footwear.title: Check Size Availability
footwear.principle: Find the size selector. Check if your exact numeric size (e.g., '9.5', '10.5') appears. If not available, leave the product immediately.

footwear.title: Select Color Then Check Price
footwear.principle: After selecting size, choose the exact color name from options. Then verify the final price is within budget. If color missing or price too high, leave.

home_decor.title: Home Search: Item Type + Color
home_decor.principle: Search format: [furniture/decor type] [color or material]. Example: 'area rug taupe', 'throw pillow blue', 'curtains white'. Keep to 3-4 words.
home_decor.when_to_apply: Before searching for home decor items.

home_decor.title: Select Shape/Size Before Color
home_decor.principle: For home items, select shape/size variant first (e.g., 'runner', '7 ft'), then select color. Don't confuse size selectors with color selectors.
home_decor.when_to_apply: On a home product page with multiple variant types.

home_decor.title: Verify Material in Description
home_decor.principle: If the task requires specific material (wood, metal, ceramic) or features (washable, waterproof), check the description to confirm before buying.
home_decor.when_to_apply: When task specifies material or features not visible in title.

home_decor.title: Buy Only After Full Verification
home_decor.principle: Click 'Buy Now' only after confirming: correct item type, correct size/shape, correct color, and price within budget. If any is missing, keep searching.

electronics.title: Electronics Search: Product + Key Spec
electronics.principle: Search format: [device type] [1 key spec]. Examples: 'bluetooth headphones noise cancelling', 'usb hub 4 port', 'phone case iphone 13'. Keep to 3-5 words.

electronics.title: Verify Model Compatibility
electronics.principle: Electronics must be compatible with specified models (e.g., 'for iPhone 13'). Check the title or description for explicit compatibility. If not stated, leave.
electronics.when_to_apply: Right after opening an electronics product page.

electronics.title: Select Technical Variants Precisely
electronics.principle: Electronics have color, storage, connectivity variants. Select each one EXACTLY matching the task. '32GB' ≠ '64GB'. If required variant not available, leave immediately.
electronics.when_to_apply: When selecting options on an electronics product page.

electronics.title: Price Varies by Variant
electronics.principle: Electronics prices vary significantly by variant (storage, bundle). After selecting your exact variant, verify price is within budget before buying.
electronics.when_to_apply: After all variant selections, before clicking buy.

accessories.title: Accessories Search: Type + Feature
accessories.principle: Search format: [accessory type] [material or feature]. Examples: 'leather wallet bifold', 'sunglasses polarized', 'watch band silicone'. Keep to 3-4 words.

accessories.title: Verify Intended Use
accessories.principle: 'Makeup bag' ≠ 'pencil case'. 'Watch band' ≠ 'bracelet'. Confirm the item's intended use matches your task before selecting variants.
accessories.when_to_apply: Right after opening an accessories product page.

accessories.title: Select Color/Pattern Exactly
accessories.principle: Match exactly: 'rose gold' ≠ 'gold', 'leopard print' ≠ 'animal print'. If your exact option isn't listed, leave and try another product.
accessories.when_to_apply: When selecting color or pattern variants.

accessories.title: Quick Buy for Simple Items
accessories.principle: Many accessories have few variants. If product type matches and color/size are correct, buy immediately. Speed matters for simple items.
accessories.when_to_apply: When product clearly matches task requirements.

beauty_health.title: Beauty Search: Product + Key Attribute
beauty_health.principle: Search format: [product type] [key feature]. Examples: 'mascara waterproof', 'face moisturizer spf', 'nail polish red'. Keep to 3-4 words. Don't include scent names or ingredient lists.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: Before searching for beauty or health products.

beauty_health.title: Verify Product Category
beauty_health.principle: 'Shampoo' ≠ 'conditioner'. 'Body lotion' ≠ 'face cream'. 'Lipstick' ≠ 'lip gloss'. Verify the title matches your exact category.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: Right after opening a beauty/health product page.

beauty_health.title: Select Shade/Scent/Size Exactly
beauty_health.principle: Match variants exactly: 'lavender' ≠ 'vanilla', 'nude pink' ≠ 'coral', '8 oz' ≠ '12 oz'. If your exact variant isn't available, leave immediately.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: When selecting variants on a beauty/health product page.

beauty_health.title: Buy Immediately When All Match
beauty_health.principle: If product type, variant, and price all match your task, click 'Buy Now' immediately. Don't browse other products or add extra steps.
beauty_health.when_to_apply: After confirming all requirements are met.

other.title: Other: Product Type + Key Feature
other.principle: For misc items (toys, sports, pet, stationery): search [product type] + [1 feature]. Examples: 'dog leash retractable', 'yoga mat thick', 'birthday candles number'. Keep to 3-4 words.

other.title: Verify Exact Item Type
other.principle: Misc items have similar-looking variants. Verify the TITLE states the exact item type you need. 'Retractable leash' ≠ just 'leash'. If type doesn't match, leave immediately.
other.when_to_apply: Right after opening any product page.

other.title: Select Options Then Buy
other.principle: Select all required variant options (color, size, style, quantity) matching your task exactly. If a required option isn't available, leave. If all match and price is within budget, buy immediately.
other.when_to_apply: After confirming the product type matches.

other.title: Simplify and Buy Quickly on Failure
other.principle: If first product fails, simplify search to just [product type]. Pick the first item matching your type, select options, and buy. Don't waste steps perfecting the search.
